data.name: Nafahat
data.gender_notes: Nafahat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nafahat is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic word 'nafaha' which means 'to breathe'. In the context of this name, it means 'breezes of mercy' coming from God. The name Nafahat carries the meaning “Breezes of mercy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nafahat usually hope their child will grow to embody breezes of mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Subtle spiritual realities that bring life and blessings.
data.etymology: Nafahat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breezes of mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafahat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نفحات
in_arabic.long_meaning: نفحات هي جمع نفح، وهو الفسحة والانبساط في الروح والبدن، ويعني في اللغة العربية أنفاس طيبة وروحانية، وقد وردت في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47، وتدل على راحة وطمأنينة القلب.

in_urdu.name: نفحات
in_urdu.meaning: نفحات کا مطلب ہے اچھی سانسوں اور روحانية
in_urdu.long_meaning: نفحات عربی زبان کا لفظ ہے، جو 'نفح' کی جمع ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سانس یا ہوا کا ایک نرم دباؤ، اور روحانیات میں اس کا استعمال اچھی اور مقدس سانسوں کے لئے ہوتا ہے، جو قلب کی راحتی اور اطمینان کا باعث ہوتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: नफहात
in_hindi.meaning: नफहात का अर्थ है अच्छी सांसें और आध्यात्मिकता
in_hindi.long_meaning: नफहात शब्द की उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छी और पवित्र सांसें, जो हृदय को शांति और सुकून प्रदान करती हैं। इस शब्द का प्रयोग इस्लामिक परंपरा में आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक संदर्भों में किया जाता है।

in_english.name: Nafahat
in_english.meaning: Nafahat means good breezes or spiritual breaths
in_english.long_meaning: Nafahat originates from the Arabic root 'n-f-h' which signifies 'to breathe' or 'breeze'. In Islamic context, Nafahat refers to good, pure, and spiritual breaths that bring comfort and peace to the heart. The term is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Hijr, verse 47. It symbolizes spiritual awakening and inner peace, embodying qualities of serenity and tranquility.
